title: Fake-DOM move: lin-3833 ×2 / lin-3968 / lin-3975 / lin-4016 / lin-4040 / lin-4042 / brief-recap ×2 / scan-retire-ui onto loadWorld
description:
Plan piece 5.

Suites: `lin-3833-copy-first-view`, `lin-3833-run-control`, `lin-3968-home-polish`, `lin-3975-task-run-control`, `lin-4016-browser-follows-server`, `lin-4040-close-out` (10 internal reads), `lin-4042-finished-no-run-to-pr`, `brief-recap-autogenerate` (3), `brief-recap-ai-not-configured-contract` and `scan-retire-ui`. They load `brief.js`/`recap.js`/`scan.js` through `loadWorld`. This is why the rename lands first: S1 is a blocker.

* `lin-4016`**: expect the stop** (review note 4). The suite hands back a `.value` getter/setter for `<select>`. `prompt-section.js:1565` writes `el.value`, and `:2775-2784` reads it. The shared fake throws on `<select>.value`, and `select` support is out of this ticket. Leave the suite on the census list, with that API named as the reason.
* Use the same assertion-map and mutation rule for `lin-4040`, `lin-3833-copy-first-view` and `brief-recap-autogenerate`.

**Done when:** every suite except an honest stop is moved, with the same test names and counts, and its census entry is gone. Stops are named with the API that caused them, and findings are classified.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: LIN-4255. Read its description's **Implementation Plan** (the approved plan) and the Plan Review Verdict comment `98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f`, which has notes for the builder. The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts. Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4255.

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no. Covered by LIN-4255's approving plan-review (comment 98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f, rev 1).
* Grounding commit: `b5391736` (LinearViewer origin/main; still HEAD when this breakdown was made on 2026-11-05).

**Rules for every move piece (from the plan):** test names and counts stay the same. Before and after, run `node --test --test-reporter=spec <file>` and paste the empty diff. Remove each moved file from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and from the `fake-dom.js` header's consumer list in the same PR. Delete both copies, the container and the `vm` sandbox. Never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals: map it to a real-DOM replacement and prove the replacement goes red under the mutation it guards. Every red is a finding, and the PR records it as fixed, filed or fake artefact. Serializer differences (`disabled=""`, escaping) are fixed in the test's regexes, never by relaxing the fake. Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js`.

## Close-out stub

Implemented as approved in LinearViewer PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2306](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2306>) (squash `069585bb`). Departures: lin-4016 moved instead of stopping (ruling d1a90030); moved suites joined the `fake-dom.js` consumer list (LIN-4255 ruling b6dfed3e). The description carried no embedded plan or research sections to prune (the plan lives on LIN-4255), so the original text above is kept. Full history is in the task snapshots and comment trail.

parent.title: The shared fake DOM becomes the one in fact: move the hand-written client test fakes onto it, with a census (LIN-4252 tidy-after)

comments.body:
**Autopilot ruling (LIN-4269): move lin-4016-browser-follows-server after all.**

Evidence from beat 4: a scratch port of lin-4016 onto `loadWorld` passes 29/29 on the real DOM. The suite never draws a decision panel (its decision-panel stub returns empty markup, `lin-4016-browser-follows-server.test.js:90`) and fires no input/change events, so the `<select>.value` getter/setter (`prompt-section.js:1561-1567`) is never reached. The ticket's "intentional stop" was a prediction (plan-review note 4 says "expected"), and the plan's own stop rule is evidence-based: stop only when a suite genuinely needs an API the shared fake does not model. This one does not, so the rule says move it. Moving it does not widen or alter the fake, so the ticket's "don't fix by adding select support" constraint still holds.

Why this is mine to decide: it is a code-quality/coherence question (keep a census entry whose stated reason is false vs. let the ratchet reflect reality), it is reversible (PR, not merged), and it follows the plan's rule rather than redefining it. The PR will flag it so a reviewer can veto.

Unchanged: lin-3833-run-control is a genuine second stop (the `<select>.value` setter throws on 11 tests' paths; `applyPanelDraft` at `prompt-section.js:1565`, read at `lin-3833-run-control.test.js:243`). It stays on the census and is not split.

The lin-4016 port gets the full discipline (names/counts unchanged, mutation proofs, findings classified). Census target: 47 -> 46.

**LIN-4269 beat 6: PR open, CI not confirmed.** PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2306 (head `d4895ca4`, base `main`). Not merged; ticket left In Progress for review.

**What moved (9 suites, names and counts unchanged vs. the beat-1 baseline):** lin-3833-copy-first-view (13), lin-3968-home-polish (15), lin-3975-task-run-control (31), lin-4040-close-out (11), lin-4042-finished-no-run-to-pr (29), brief-recap-autogenerate (10), brief-recap-ai-not-configured-contract (6), scan-retire-ui (13), lin-4016-browser-follows-server (29). Census 55 → 46.

**Stop:** lin-3833-run-control stays on the census, unsplit. Production writes `<select>.value` through `applyPanelDraft` (`public/prompt-section.js:1565`), the test reads it at `lin-3833-run-control.test.js:243`, and the fake's setter throws on 11 test paths. Scratch port: 24/46 red.

**Flag for review: lin-4016 departs from the ticket text.** It was named an intentional `<select>.value` stop. Its tests never touch a select (throwing-accessor probe: 0 hits, positive control caught, 29/29 on the real DOM), so it was moved under the plan's evidence rule. Revert steps are in the PR body.

**Consumer list:** moved suites joined the `fake-dom.js` header consumer list, per the LIN-4255 ruling (b6dfed3e), not the ticket's removal wording.

**Evidence:** census 43/43, fake-dom 51/51, claude-md-line-budget 2/2. Full unit suite: branch 23608 pass / 0 fail, main `473cc865` 23608 / 0, identical empty failure-name lists.

**CI: not confirmed.** `.github/workflows/test.yml` runs on `pull_request` to `main`, and Actions is enabled with runs on other PRs. But no run was created for head `d4895ca4` in roughly six minutes (Actions API: 0 runs for that SHA; `gh pr checks` reports none). I did not claim green. Someone should check why the Tests workflow did not start for PR 2306.

**Only production change:** `public/style.css` (`.opened-task-copy.copied`), a fix for the task-page copied state. Everything else is test files, the census, and the fake-dom header comments.

Someone with Actions access checks why no run started

— Ruling recorded via Harbour

**LIN-4269 beat 7: merge resolved, CI green on the new head.** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2306, head `95cced23`. Mergeable: CLEAN. Not merged; ticket left In Progress for review.

**CI:** Tests run https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/actions/runs/42056338266 completed success on head `95cced23`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan, CI success. The earlier head `d4895ca4` never started Tests because the PR was CONFLICTING. Main had moved, so I merged it, with no force-push.

**Merge:** main moved twice (LIN-4268 `8369461c`, LIN-4280 `82e75ee9`). Conflicts were only in the `fake-dom.js` consumer-list paragraph, resolved by union.

**Census:** this branch takes main from 47 to **38** (main 47 minus this ticket's nine). Counted: 38 entries, no duplicates, sorted, no moved suite listed. The census was 55 at ticket start and is 46 on the branch before the merge. Only stop: `lin-3833-run-control`.

**Evidence:** full unit suite merged head 23708 / 0; main `82e75ee9` 23708 / 0; identical empty failure-name lists. Census 43 → 38 tests and fake-dom 51/51 are green on the merged tree, with `claude-md-line-budget` 2/2 and `client-world` 3/3. The nine moved suites' spec-name diffs are empty, and the LIN-4268/4280 suites are green.

Correction to my previous comment on this ticket: the census line there read "Census 43 → 38 tests", which is wrong. The census is 38 entries after the merge (main 47 minus this ticket's nine). The fake-dom test count is 51/51, and the census test is 43/43. No other figures changed.

**Autopilot run summary (stepper, 7 beats, one warm session): LIN-4269 implementation is up for review. PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2306 (head `95cced23`, not merged; ticket left In Progress).**

**Beats:** 1 ground/baseline/map (203 tests, 10 suites, all green) -> 2 lin-3833-copy-first-view / lin-3968 / lin-3975 -> 3 lin-4040 / lin-4042 / brief-recap x2 / scan-retire-ui -> 4 select probes + consistency check -> (my ruling, below) 5 lin-4016 port -> 6 push + PR -> 7 resolve conflict with main + CI.

**What I checked myself (not just the worker's word):**
- CI on head `95cced23`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan and the `CI success` gate all SUCCESS (run https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/actions/runs/42056338266). PR is MERGEABLE / CLEAN.
- Why CI had not started on the first head `d4895ca4`: the PR was CONFLICTING with main (LIN-4268 / LIN-4280 touched the same census and `fake-dom.js` lines), and GitHub does not run `pull_request` workflows on a conflicting PR. Fixed by merging main (plain merges, no force-push), not by an empty-commit re-trigger.
- Census on the PR head: all nine moved suites are gone from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES`; `lin-3833-run-control` remains. Delta against main is exactly 9 (worker states 47 -> 38).
- Locally (worker): names/counts identical to the beat-1 baseline for all nine moved suites; full unit suite 23608 pass / 0 fail on the branch and on main with identical empty failure-name lists. Mutation proofs went red then restored for every replaced assertion.

**Stops / departures for the reviewer:**
- `lin-3833-run-control`: genuine stop on `<select>.value` (setter throws on 11 test paths; `prompt-section.js:1565`, test line 243). Stays on the census, unsplit; fake not widened.
- `lin-4016`: the ticket called it a stop; evidence says it never touches a select (0 hits with throwing accessor, positive control caught; 29/29 on the real DOM), so it was moved under the plan's evidence-based rule (ruling d1a90030 / 4a2a2dce). Revert steps are in the PR body. This is the one call a reviewer may want to veto.
- Consumer-list: followed LIN-4255 ruling b6dfed3e (moved suites join the header list) rather than the ticket's "remove" wording.
- Only production change: `.opened-task-copy.copied` rule added to `public/style.css` (real bug the fake hid).

**Not mine / still open:** the stray "Someone with Actions access checks why no run started" ruling recorded at 15:42Z answers the worker's CI-trigger question, which is moot now that CI ran green after the conflict fix. Review, then close-out (merge/Done), are separate dispatched steps; the PR is 1 commit behind main but clean.

## Review — LIN-4269

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2306 at head `95cced23` (branch `feat/lin-4269-fake-dom-loadworld`).

CI: green on `95cced23` (run 42056338266: Unit tests, E2E 1-4, Secret scan, CI success). main has since moved to `aeb9d877` (LIN-4279), so that run does not cover the merged tree. See the ledger.

**Scope versus plan.** Nine suites moved. `lin-3833-run-control` stays as the one stop. The 12 changed files match the plan's places: the nine suites, the census, the `fake-dom.js` header, and `public/style.css`. `client-world.js` and the fake's behaviour are unchanged. There are two departures from the ticket text, and both have recorded rulings:
- lin-4016 moved instead of stopping (ruling d1a90030).
- Moved suites joined the consumer list instead of being removed from it (LIN-4255 ruling b6dfed3e).

I accept lin-4016's move. I re-ran it: 29/29 on the real fake, and its census entry is gone. The fake was not widened. On merged main, `<select>.value` still throws ("not modelled on <select>").

**My own checks:**
- **Spec names and counts, main vs. PR, all nine suites:** the diff is empty. Counts are 13 / 15 / 31 / 11 / 29 / 10 / 6 / 13 / 29, with 0 failures.
- **Shared-fake tests:** census 43/43, fake-dom 51/51, client-world 3/3. The census has 38 entries. `lin-3833-run-control` is still listed; none of the moved suites are.
- **Sandbox copies:** no moved suite keeps its own `makeContainer` or vm sandbox. `brief-recap-ai-not-configured-contract` calls `vm.runInContext` on `world.sandbox`, which is the shared world, not a copy. That is fine.
- **Mutations I ran myself, each reverted afterwards:**
  - Removed the `.opened-task-copy.copied` CSS rule: lin-3975 went 2 red.
  - Removed the retire `confirm()` in scan.js:389: scan-retire-ui went 2 red.
  - Made `takesNoRun` return false: lin-4042 went 15 red.
  - Removed `data-brief-refresh` from the Brief generate button: brief-recap-autogenerate went 2 red.
  - All four match the PR's claimed counts.
- **Merged tree (PR + `origin/main` `aeb9d877`), local merge:** census, fake-dom (now 87), client-world, the nine moved suites and `lin-3833-run-control` (46) are all green.
- **Regression:** `style.css` history shows no revert of a copied-state rule. The new rule is additive.
- **One of a class?** The other hand-written fakes on the census belong to sibling tickets: LIN-4267, LIN-4271, and the LIN-4272 classification. That puts them outside this ticket's bounded list. Within its list, this ticket is complete.

**Fixes for close-out to make (small, test-only):**
1. `tests/unit/lin-4040-close-out.test.js:16-31`: delete `replaceSlot`. Only the removed hand-written `makeContainer` used it, so it is now dead code. Also lines 3-4 still say "Same vm-sandbox house pattern as prompt-section-run-quota.test.js". Change that to say the suite runs in the shared client world (`helpers/client-world.js`).
2. In the PR body's Findings table, row 5 (`container.click()` does not bubble to button-level listeners) is classified as "Shared-helper gap". That is not one of the allowed classes (fixed / filed / fake artefact). Reclassify it as **fake artefact**: the fake documents that it does not model bubbling, and the suites now press the drawn button's own listeners.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (the deliverable is the move landing on main): CI ran on `95cced23`, but main has since gained LIN-4279 `aeb9d877`, which changed `fake-dom.js` and `client-world.js`. The merge is textually clean, and my local merged run of the affected suites is green. Neither is CI on the merged tree. **Before the merge:** update the branch with main and confirm Tests is green on the new head. Right means Unit tests and E2E 1-4 pass with census 43/43.
- **Inside** (the only production change, a real bug the move surfaced): `.opened-task-copy.copied` gives the task-surface Copy button the green copied state. A static CSS check in lin-3975 covers that the rule exists. No test renders it. **After the deploy:** on a task page, press Copy on the opened-task prompt. Right means the button turns green (text and border `--green`) for about 2s, then reverts. Wrong means it stays unstyled. **Rollback:** revert the `public/style.css` hunk from `5f9d1da5`.
- lin-4016's departure from the ticket text is **discharged**: this review independently confirmed it (29/29 on the real fake, select still unmodelled, census entry correctly removed).

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. Every listed suite except the honest `<select>.value` stop has moved, with unchanged names and counts. I re-ran the mutation proofs myself and they go red where claimed. What remains is the two small fixes above and re-confirming CI on a head that includes current main.

## Close-out — LIN-4269

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2306, squash commit `069585bb`, pinned with `--match-head-commit c3a26449`. Deployed: harbour.cat footer shows `069585b`. Nine suites moved onto `loadWorld` with unchanged names and counts; `lin-3833-run-control` stays on the census as the only `<select>.value` stop. Census 47 → 38 on main.

**Changes I made after the approval (both test/PR-text only):**
- `c3a26449`: deleted dead `replaceSlot` and the stale "vm-sandbox house pattern" header in `tests/unit/lin-4040-close-out.test.js`. Answers review fix 1. The suite is still 11/11.
- PR body Findings row 5 (`container.click()` bubbling) reclassified from "Shared-helper gap" to **fake artefact**. Answers review fix 2.
- Before that, I merged main `aeb9d877` into the branch (clean, no conflicts) so CI would cover the merged tree.

**Ledger:**
- *Inside, CI not covering the merged tree* — settled. Tests ran on `c3a26449`, which contains `aeb9d877`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan and CI success all passed. Locally census 43/43, fake-dom, client-world and line-budget were 135/135. Main's own Tests run on the merge commit also passed (run 42060683751).
- *Inside, `.opened-task-copy.copied` visual* — partly settled. After deploy I confirmed the live `/style.css` serves the rule (color and border `var(--green)`), identical to main. **Not run:** pressing Copy on a task page to see the button turn green for about 2s. I have no signed-in browser session. Anyone who can open a task page can run it. Rollback as named in the review: revert the `public/style.css` hunk from `5f9d1da5`.
- *lin-4016 departure* — discharged by review.
- No outside items, so nothing was filed. LIN-4272 (Todo) is not settled by this and stays open; LIN-4255 and its other children are untouched.

**Final CI state:** green on the merged head, and green on main after the merge.

Note: the ruling "Someone with Actions access checks why no run started" is moot. CI had not started because the PR conflicted with main; it ran green once main was merged.
